section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the theoretical framework and aim of the study. It defines loneliness as a subjective experience of isolation and lack of satisfying relationships, and hypothesizes that gratitude can reduce loneliness by counteracting distorted thinking and increasing social competence. The study aims to investigate the role of gratitude in reducing loneliness feelings, while also considering confounding factors such as social desirability bias and other positive emotions like life satisfaction and subjective happiness.
